children: The Singapore dollar consolidates against its U.S. counterpart, but prospects of rate increases by the Federal Reserve could weigh on the Asian currency. The U.S. dollar strengthened overnight, as the selloff in global bonds continued, Maybank analysts say in a report. Rising oil prices also add to inflation concerns and reinforce expectations that the Fed's tightening cycle may have further room to run, the analysts add. The U.S. dollar is flat at 1.2791 Singapore dollars, LSEG data show. (amanda.lee@wsj.com)
